# VivahSambandh

> VivahSambandh is India's trusted premium Community Matrimony platform connecting verified Agarwal, Jain, Khandelwal and Maheshwari families with shared traditions, Gotra compatibility, and values for lifelong relationships. Content is available in English and Hindi (हिन्दी).

## Pages

- [Home (English)](https://vivahsambandh.com/): hero, about, city matches, features, success stories, app download, FAQ, contact
- [Home (Hindi)](https://vivahsambandh.com/hi): same content in Hindi (हिन्दी)

## Sections

- [About](https://vivahsambandh.com/#about): community, verification, Membership
- [City matches](https://vivahsambandh.com/#search): Delhi, Mumbai, Kolkata, Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Pune, Ahmedabad
- [Success stories](https://vivahsambandh.com/#stories): couple testimonials
- [FAQ](https://vivahsambandh.com/#faq): verification, gotra search, matching process
- [Contact](https://vivahsambandh.com/#contact): support email and phone
